questions.question: How can I authenticate my e-mail address?
questions.answer: After registration, we will send a letter to the email address you provided, which contains a link to verify the email address. By clicking on the link, the email address provided during registration will be authenticated. If the email has not arrived, it is worth checking the spam folder. In case of need, contact customer service!

questions.question: Can I register with other details?
questions.answer: You can only register in your own name, using the personal data found in your documents.

questions.question: Can I change my username?
questions.answer: No, the username cannot be changed.

questions.question: What are the registration conditions?
questions.answer: On the BetMatchBonus site, only bettors who have turned 18 years of age, have a place of residence in Hungary and have a HUF-denominated bank account in a Hungarian bank can register. At the time of registration, all players must accept the Participation Rules and the data protection policy.

questions.question: How can I register?
questions.answer: Click on the Registration button in the upper right corner, then enter the required data. At the end of the registration, we will send an activation link to your email address.

questions.question: What can I do if I entered the wrong data during registration?
questions.answer: After logging in, you can change your data in the Settings/Personal data menu, except for the username and sales data. These can be repaired by customer service.

questions.question: Can I change my password?
questions.answer: You can change your password in the profile menu. After entering the old password, a new password must be entered and then approved with the code received by email.

questions.question: What must be declared during registration?
questions.answer: You must declare that you participate in your own name, provide your own data, accept the Rules of Participation and the data management policy.

questions.question: Can I register more than once?
questions.answer: No, each player can create only one registration. If you have problems logging in, contact our customer service.

questions.question: There have been changes in my personal data. What can I do?
questions.answer: You must modify the changes within 5 days in the Settings/Personal data menu. The slice data can only be corrected by customer service.

questions.question: Can I use master intelligence during my bets?
questions.answer: BetMatchBonus forbids the use of any kind of artificial intelligence, and any device, software or service that plays without human intervention or reduces human decision-making urgency, or automated decision-making, or real-time advice ("bots"), and takes all steps to prevent and detect the use of such tools interest.

questions.question: What should I do if my bet is closed but the prize is not claimed?
questions.answer: If the conclusion of a winning bet has already taken place, but the prize has not been included in the "Prize balance", then our email customer service can help you with the matter.

questions.question: How many events can I combine in one bet?
questions.answer: A minimum of 1 and a maximum of 50 betting events can be accepted in one bet.

questions.question: What's my partner?
questions.answer: The number of bets shows that each bet accepted by the bettor contains how many accepted outcomes.

questions.question: What is multiple knitting?
questions.answer: It is called multiple betting if the outcome of several sports events is betted on one ticket at the same time. Then the winning multipliers are multiplied. Example: A bettor bets HUF 1,000 on 3 events, where in all three cases he bets on the victory of the home team. Barcelona â€“ Real Madrid (H â€“ 1.35), FerencvĂˇros â€“ Ăjpest (H â€“ 1.40), Bologna â€“ Milan (H â€“ 2.45). HUF 630 will be added to your ``Winning balance''.

questions.question: Can multiple betting options for a match be bet in all cases?
questions.answer: Among the betting options included in the betting offer, betting options belonging to the same sports event may be banned.

questions.question: Can the winning multipliers be changed?
questions.answer: The winning multiplier of any bettable outcome belonging to any betting event can be changed. In such a case, for the possible outcomes of the given betting event, for the bets placed before the prize multiplier change(s), the winning multipliers valid at the time of placing the bet, the winning multipliers made after the prize multiplier change(s) for bets, the modified prize multipliers are valid. During a live bet, the winning odds are constantly changing based on the situations, situations, and events of the sports event.

questions.question: How long does it take to settle bets?
questions.answer: We will try to settle the bets as soon as possible after the completion of the promised events, their official results and their control. The deadline for determining the result is the 48th hour after the end of the betting event for the last person affected by the bet.

questions.question: How do I know I've won?
questions.answer: After logging in, you can view both open and closed bets under the ``Diary'' menu item. If a closed bet is a winner, the winning amount can be seen in connection with it.

questions.question: Is there a maximum prize?
questions.answer: Yes. The amount of the largest prize that can be won with a single bet is the legal amount, i.e. HUF 2,000,000.

questions.question: Is there a maximum bet?
questions.answer: Yes. The amount of the largest bet is the amount provided for in the legislation in force at all times, but no more than HUF 100,000 per single bet.

questions.question: Can the bet be withdrawn if I change my mind?
questions.answer: Not. Bets already placed in games cannot be withdrawn or changed. Therefore, in any case, even before approving the bet, you must make sure whether you have selected the desired event and winning multiplier. With the cash out function, however, you can withdraw from your bet after placing the bet, but before the end of the events - if the cash out can reach your bet.

questions.question: Is there a minimum bet?
questions.answer: Yes. The minimum bet that can be placed during a bet is HUF 100 as a standard and also in the case of a combined bet.

questions.question: How can I bet?
questions.answer: After logging in, scroll to the desired sport, then select the desired sports event and click on the multiplier. The tip or tips will be visible on the right side of the screen, in the ``Slideshow''. Then enter the amount you want to play as a bet. If you have this, you can send your slip to the game by pressing the "Accept" button.

questions.question: How can I bet live?
questions.answer: After logging in, you can access the events that can be accepted in advance by clicking on the page at the top of the screen. For sports, after selecting the sports event, it is necessary to click on the multiplier. The tip or tips will be visible on the right side of the screen in the ``Slice''. Then enter the amount you want to play as a bet. If you have this, you can send your slip to the game by pressing the "Accept" button.

questions.question: Where do I see my bets?
questions.answer: After logging in, you can view and retrieve your bets in the "Diary" section. By clicking on the "More" button, you can find even more details about your open or calculated bet. For estimated bets, the search can also be started for a predetermined period of time. Bets can be found in the betting log in the order they were sent to games.

questions.question: Asian score
questions.answer: The Asian goal number is similar to traditional goal number tip bets, with the difference that here a result may occur, as a result of which the bet is taken into account with a multiplier of 1, or the bet there will be a winner or a loser in part. Separate from the normal Asian goal number, we offer whole or half-digit Asian goal numbers. With the traditional goal score, a bet is either a winner or a loser. On the other hand, in the case of certain results, the bet with a prize multiplier of 1 is taken into account for the Asian goal score. In the case of a double Asian score, the bet consists of a whole and a half Asian score, as if both values ​​had been bet with a half bet. In all cases, its marking is quarter-pointed (ending in â€¦.25 or â€¦..75) depending on which half or whole number the offered difference falls on. Further information can be found in No. 3 of the participation regulations. in Annex B (2). The specified limit values ​​can be whole, half or quarter goals: â€˘ Asian whole number goals (2, 3, 4): If exactly as many goals are scored in the match as the specified number, the bet is returned. â€˘ Half-digit Asian goals (2.5, 3.5): There is no possibility of return, the bet can only win or lose. â€˘ Quarter Goals Scores (2.25, 2.75): The bet is divided into two parts, and the bet can be partly won or partly lost. Examples: â€˘ More than 2 goals: The bet wins if more than 2 goals are scored; the bet returns if exactly 2 goals are scored; lose if less than 2 goals are scored. â€˘ More than 2.5 goals: The bet wins if at least 3 goals are scored; you lose if there are 2 or less goals.â€˘ More than 2.25 goals: Half of the bet is placed on the "more than 2 goals" and the other half on the "more than 2.5 goals" bet. If 2 goals are scored, half of the bet is returned, the other half is lost; if 3 or more goals are scored, the entire bet is won; if less than 2 goals are scored, the entire bet is lost.

questions.question: Number of penalty sheets
questions.answer:
The number of penalty cards can be determined based on the number of yellow card(s) and red card(s) distributed in the given match. If a player receives a yellow card, it counts as a penalty card. If a player receives a red card, it counts as two penalty cards. If a player receives a yellow card and a red card, it counts as three penalty cards in total. If a player receives two yellow cards followed by a red card, it also counts as three penalty cards in total. It is therefore important to know that a player can receive a maximum of three penalty cards during a match.
During the match, only during regular play, the penalty cards distributed to the players on the field are counted in determining the result. Except for the one following the first half - to the players on the field at the end of the first half of the match - penalty cards are awarded, which must be counted in the 2nd half.

questions.question: Can I claim several bonus offers at the same time?
questions.answer: Yes, if the conditions of participation do not specify that you can only claim one of two or more simultaneous bonuses at the same time. It is important to know that the fulfillment of bonuses takes place in the order of the request, so if you fulfill the conditions of several bonuses with one bet, it will always count towards the rotation of the bonus requested earliest in time.

questions.question: How can I claim my top-up bonus?
questions.answer: You can activate the upload bonus by entering your bonus code on the Payment sub-page or selecting the bonus by clicking on the gift box icon. Whichever method you choose, the bonus will be activated with your deposit.

questions.question: Why did I fail to claim the bonus?
questions.answer: It may happen that you have entered your bonus code incorrectly and that is why you cannot claim it.

questions.question: What happens if I cancel my bonus?
questions.answer: If you cancel the bonus, you will lose the entire amount in your bonus balance, so you will also lose any winnings you may have achieved. A bonus can only be claimed once, it cannot be restored after cancellation.

questions.question: Why can't I bet on every event from my bonus?
questions.answer: There are bonuses that you can use for a specific event or a specific championship. You can find it in the conditions of participation.

questions.question: What does the filming requirement mean?
questions.answer: The wagering requirement means how many times you have to wager your bonus in order for your winnings to be transferred to your winnings balance. If you participated in a HUF 1,000 bonus and the turnover requirement is 2x, then you must turnover your bonus worth a total of HUF 2,000 to fulfill this condition.

questions.question: Do I have to redeem my bonus immediately after the request?
questions.answer: It is not necessary, the terms of participation of the given bonus offer provide information about the deadline for requesting the bonus and fulfilling the turnover requirements.

questions.question: Do I have to roll over the bonus in one sum?
questions.answer: The wagering requirements are always included in the conditions of participation, you can track the fulfillment of the given bonus offer in the My Bonuses menu.

questions.question: Can I use my bonus for several bets at the same time so that it is included in the turnover conditions?
questions.answer: No, per event, only the first placed bet is included in the fulfillment of the filming conditions.

questions.question: Can I only bet from the bonus or can I also use my own balance?
questions.answer: You can bet from the bonus as well as from your own balance, but remember that this only counts towards the fulfillment of the wagering requirements up to the amount of the given bonus. This means that if you receive a bonus of HUF 2,500 without making a bet worth HUF 3,000, it counts up to HUF 2,500 towards the fulfillment of the wagering requirements.

questions.question: If you want to bet from the bonus, is any amount included in the wagering requirements?
questions.answer: No, the bonus amount is always included in the fulfillment of the conditions of rotation. Therefore, if you receive a bonus of HUF 1,000 but place a bet worth HUF 3,000, up to HUF 1,000 will be added to the fulfillment of the wagering requirements.

questions.question: If I want to bet from a bonus, why do I get a message that I don't have enough money in my balance?
questions.answer: In this case, one of the rotation requirements is not met, so the bet would be charged to your paid balance - however, this is not enough. Such a case, for example, if the odds conditions specified in the rotation requirements are not met or your slip is a contains an event that you have already bet on.

questions.question: How can it happen that part of my winnings is applied to my bonus balance and the other part to my winnings balance?
questions.answer: The reason for this is that the winnings from the bet made from the bonus balance are applied to the bonus balance, and the winnings from the bets paid and made from the winnings balance are applied to the winnings balance. In this case, you made your bet not only from the bonus balance (since the amount you bet for was not available). You have no option to decide whether you want to bet from bonus or paid-in and/or prize balance. If your bet meets the bonus offer's participation conditions, the system will primarily deduct the bet from your bonus balance.

questions.question: Why hasn't my entire winnings been transferred to my winnings balance?
questions.answer: Every bonus has a limit on how much you can transfer to your prize balance, you can always find this in the conditions of participation.

questions.question: What happens to my winnings if I bet from a bonus and one of my bets was assessed as a loss for the first time and then changed to a winner?
questions.answer: In this case, the prize will not be added to the completed bonus amount.
